name: Malav Rana
headline: Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications using React, Angular, Vue, and Next.js. Strong in HTML5, CSS3, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and front-end performance optimization. Experienced in fast-paced, cross-functional teams, delivering accessible, maintainable UIs that improve usability and client outcomes.

skillDescriptions.Front-End Technologies: Expert-level proficiency in modern JavaScript frameworks and libraries. Building scalable, performant applications with React.js, Angular, Vue.js, Next.js, and TypeScript. Strong foundation in HTML5, CSS3, modern CSS frameworks (Tailwind, CSS Modules, Styled Components), state management (Redux, Context), and React Hooks for responsive, accessible design.
skillDescriptions.Web Technologies: Specialized in REST/GraphQL API integrations, client-side data handling, and performance optimization. Experienced with form validation, browser debugging, web fundamentals (Event Loop, HTTP, Caching), frontend security (XSS, CSRF, CORS), and authentication (JWT, OAuth) for secure, efficient real-time applications.
skillDescriptions.Testing & Tools: Comprehensive testing expertise with Jest, React Testing Library, and end-to-end testing (Playwright, Cypress). Proficient in modern development workflows using Git, Bitbucket, GitHub Actions, build tools (Webpack, Vite, Babel), code quality tools (ESLint, Prettier), package managers (npm, yarn), AWS, Docker, Jenkins CI/CD, and design collaboration (Figma).

experience.tagline: Kiswe is a platform that powers live interactive experiences for sports, media, and enterprise brands.
experience.description: Focused on rebuilding and modernizing the Comment Center UI to better support real-time operations during live events. Contributed to Kiswe's internal UI component library, creating reusable, scalable components that improve consistency and make development faster. Known for taking ownership of tasks, communicating well across teams, and delivering work that is both efficient and maintainable.
highlights: Designed, developed, and deployed custom web applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React, and Vue, delivering scalable front-end solutions aligned with business requirements.
Implemented complex client-side logic, interactive workflows, and form validation to ensure seamless user interactions across browsers and devices.
Integrated and maintained RESTful APIs for real-time data handling and smooth client-side interaction with backend systems.
Optimized front-end performance through reusable components, efficient code structuring, and browser debugging tools to improve reliability during high-traffic live events.

experience.tagline: Gensler is a global architecture and design firm that also builds enterprise digital tools.
experience.description: Built large-scale web applications for internal teams and clients, turning complex requirements into clean, accessible, and scalable interfaces. Worked closely with designers, product managers, and engineers to deliver front-end systems that are maintainable and easy to use.
highlights: Built enterprise-grade web interfaces using React, Angular, Vue, and Next.js, following modern front-end development best practices.
Developed responsive, adaptive UIs with HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and Tailwind CSS, ensuring accessibility and consistent UX across devices.
Managed client-side data manipulation and querying through RESTful APIs and GraphQL, enabling efficient communication with backend services.
Improved performance and stability through front-end optimization techniques, automated testing with Jest, and use of browser debugging tools.

experience.tagline: Express Scripts, part of Cigna, provides pharmacy benefits and digital healthcare solutions.
experience.description: Developed customer-facing pharmacy workflows, ensuring interfaces were reliable, clear, and easy to navigate. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate complex backend logic while keeping the experience smooth and accessible.
highlights: Designed and implemented interactive web workflows for online pharmacy applications using React, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+).
Built and maintained client-side integrations with backend services using RESTful APIs, supporting accurate real-time updates.
Implemented form validation, state-driven UI logic, and client-side data handling to ensure reliable, user-friendly checkout experiences.
Applied performance optimization techniques (e.g., lazy loading, code splitting) to reduce load times and improve responsiveness.

experience.tagline: Atmiya Care is a nonprofit supporting community outreach and charitable initiatives.
experience.description: Built web platforms to support donations and community engagement. Delivered features end-to-end in a fast-moving environment, focusing on usability, performance, and real-world impact.
highlights: Developed and deployed custom web solutions using React, Angular, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript to support donation and community engagement platforms.
Implemented RESTful API integrations and client-side data handling to deliver dynamic, real-time user experiences.
Ensured compliance with accessibility (WCAG) and responsive design principles across browsers and devices.
Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver polished, production-ready web applications.
